course_summary:
ISEN 633 / 433 | BIOMECHANICS OF WORK | Spring 2026
Instructor: Dr. Xudong Zhang | xudongzhang@tamu.edu
Grading: Homework #1-Group Project [10%], Homework #2-Individual Project [8%], Homework #3-Group Project [10%], Homework #4-Final Group Project (undergraduate) [15%], Homework #4-Final Group Project (graduate students) [10%], Literature review (graduate students) [5%], Exam 1 [25%], Exam 2 [30%], Miscellaneous [2%]
Graduate Grade Scale: A: 90-100, B: 75-89.9, C: 60-74.9, D: 48-59.9, F: 0-47.9
Undergrad Grade Scale: A: 85-100, B: 72-84.9, C: 60-71.9, D: 48-59.9, F: 0-47.9
Topics: Low Back & Strength Prediction Models, Biomechanical Models of Hand, Manual Material Handling Limits, Biomechanics of Sitting & Sedentary Work Design, Biomechanical Considerations in Machine Control and Workplace Design, Bioinstrumentation for Occupational Biomechanics, Anthropometry Measurements and Data, Work Classification and Analysis Systems, Range of Motion, Muscle Strength, mechanical behavior of the human musculoskeletal system, component tissues, physical work, biomechanical concepts, principles, tools, methods, measurement of human physical attributes, evaluation of human mechanical capabilities, modeling of the human musculoskeletal system, human physical performances, recognition and control of the risk of musculoskeletal disorders, Occupational Biomechanics, Fundamentals of Musculoskeletal System, Biomechanical Models, work, daily living activities
Prerequisites: ISEN 330 Human Systems Interaction; ISEN 630
